findings.summary: Rest unchanged decisions on deterministic cross-pin trace replay, not on live traces repeating; record trace digests and the legacy-diagnostic control as observations.
Pin the journal's state identities in a test so a later framing change forces a genesis schema bump.
Add source_pins verify markers to the dependency-policy controls and narrow the post-sync traceability task.
Keep the append probe as a documented ignored benchmark with named sizes and record its environment and statistics.
Ground unchanged decisions in the unique insertion rank dimension rather than in unchanged candidate identities.
Align the conformance test's default-profile bounds with Campaign 4a669ead.
Correct the counts, name prepare-public-source, and cite the unified AGPL dependency policy.
State that only Nix asserts its own pin and restore the Cargo/Nix agreement residual risk.
Record acquisition from an empty Cargo home and a refreshed Nix fetch.
Add the unservable-endpoint case to the source-pins negative scenario.
Qualify that only a kept earlier binary or cache can resume earlier-framing journals.
Record the journal-framing test runs before checking the task.
Recount the clean smoke journal and size the benchmark from it.
Limit the cross-pin replay claim to each pin's legacy-run observations.
Replace the equal-trace non-claim with the zero-drift receipt wording.
Size benchmark records from the census and cite the measured payload range.
Narrow the slowdown claim, bind the control binaries, and record a residual risk.
Commit the two distinct parity receipts as evidence.
